title: Product page: struck-through regular price in live mode
desc: The detail API gives special.endsAt but no regularPrice, so the live product page shows the Special price label without a struck-through Was price. Needs the detail response to carry regularPrice with the was-price rule's decision (28-of-90 days) taken in promotions.
src: Storefront live gaps report, slice E and B2 (26 Nov 2026)
